scripts.build: SITE_MODE=preview node scripts/build-site.mjs && vite build --mode preview && node scripts/check-build.mjs preview
scripts.production:build: SITE_MODE=production node scripts/build-site.mjs && SITE_MODE=production vite build --mode production && node scripts/check-build.mjs production
scripts.deploy:preview: npm run preview:build && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode preview --provision false
scripts.deploy:production: npm run production:build && cf deploy --prebuilt --mode production --provision false
scripts.typecheck: cf workers types && astro check && tsc --noEmit
